proposals.issue_title: GitHub Runner IP Blocking & Rate Limits on Free Image APIs
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runner IPs are highly shared and frequently flagged/blacklisted (HTTP 403/429) by Cloudflare, AI Horde, and Gemini. This causes silent pipeline crashes and prevents stable image generation.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified `image_generator.py` gateway module with built-in retry logic, exponential backoff, and a dynamic fallback sequence (Together AI FLUX-schnell -> Cloudflare Workers AI -> Runware PAYG as paid fallback -> Pollinations as absolute last resort).
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates random pipeline failures; guarantees image generation completes on every runner execution.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Listing Metadata Generation
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines generate visual assets, but Hugo has to manually write SEO titles, descriptions, and tags/keywords from his Android phone, consuming his limited 10 hours/week.
proposals.proposed_fix: Append a metadata generation step using Gemini 2.5 Flash at the end of each production pipeline. Output a standardized `listing_package.json` containing optimized Etsy/KDP titles, descriptions, and 13 tags, ready for easy copy-pasting.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves 15-20 minutes of manual work per listing, maximizing Hugo's 10h/week ROI.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Pipeline Failures and Status Blindness on Mobile
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates exclusively from an Android phone. Checking GitHub Actions logs to see if a workflow failed or succeeded is cumbersome and leads to delayed reactions to errors.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight Telegram or Discord webhook notifier step at the end of every GitHub Action workflow. Send a structured message containing: Status (Success/Fail), Pipeline Name, Number of Assets Generated, and API costs incurred.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Immediate visibility of system health and cost tracking directly on Hugo's phone.

proposals.issue_title: Gibberish Text on Generated Visual Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: AI image generators (even FLUX) occasionally render malformed text, spelling errors, or visual artifacts on typography-heavy designs, making them unsellable.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate an automated OCR/VLM gate using the free Gemini 2.5 Flash API inside `agent_gemini_quality_check`. Pass the generated image to Gemini and ask it to transcribe the text and rate its visual legibility. Auto-discard and regenerate images failing this check.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures zero typo-ridden products reach the upload stage; maintains high brand reputation.

proposals.current_pain_description: High-quality line art or graphic patterns are generated for a single product type (e.g., a coloring book page) and then archived. They are not repurposed into other profitable formats.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a post-generation utility that takes approved high-resolution graphics and automatically processes them into multiple SKUs: 1) Vectorized SVGs for Etsy, 2) Transparent PNGs for Redbubble stickers, and 3) Compiled PDFs for KDP interiors.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory volume by 3x to 4x for the same API generation cost.

proposals.issue_title: Clunky GitHub Action Triggering from Android Termux
proposals.current_pain_description: Triggering specific workflows with custom inputs through the GitHub mobile web interface is frustrating on a small touch screen.
proposals.proposed_fix: Write a simple, interactive CLI bash script for Termux using `gh workflow run` and `fzf` (or basic `read` prompts) allowing Hugo to trigger, monitor, and cancel workflows directly from his terminal.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces pipeline initiation friction to under 15 seconds from a mobile terminal.

proposals.issue_title: No Limit Controls on PAYG API Budgets
proposals.current_pain_description: If a workflow enters an infinite loop or runs unchecked on automated triggers, Runware PAYG or other paid APIs could quickly exhaust Hugo's strict €20/month budget.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a local file-based budget tracker (`/tmp/monthly_spend.json` synced via cache or repository variables) that tracks API credit usage. Stop execution immediately if the current month's spend exceeds the €20 ceiling.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates the risk of unexpected bill shock, ensuring 100% compliance with financial constraints.
